# AI Policy

Source: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/ai_policy
Retrieved: 2026-08-15

We support using AI as tools when contributing to Open Home Foundation
projects. You are responsible for any contributions you submit.

Maintainers dedicate time to reviewing contributions. Submitting
AI-generated content that you have not personally reviewed and understood
wastes that time and will not be accepted.

## Autonomous agents

We do not allow autonomous agents to be used for contributing to our
projects. Pull requests or issues believed to be created autonomously will
be closed. This includes contributions that bypass the provided issue or
pull request templates.

## Communication

Do not have tools post unreviewed content on your behalf. Keep responses to
the minimum needed. If you open a pull request, you must be able to explain
the proposed changes in your own words.

Do not use AI to generate answers to questions from maintainers. Grammar
and clarity help is fine. Quoted AI context must be disclosed and short.

## Code and documentation

All contributions must be reviewed and understood by the contributor before
submission. You should be able to explain every change. Pull requests that
appear to be unreviewed AI output will be closed without review.

## Enforcement

Contributions that do not follow this policy will be closed. Repeated
violations may result in being blocked from contributing to OHF projects.
